title: FBN Monthly Storage Rate Card
content:
Monthly storage in Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) is charged per cubic foot on the average daily cubic feet of each SKU in the storage month. Rates depend on the program, the storage class of the SKU and the season.

## Storage rates (USD per cubic foot per month)

| Program | Standard class, January to September | Standard class, October to December | Oversize class, January to September | Oversize class, October to December |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 0.78 | 2.40 | 0.56 | 1.40 |
| FBN Core Program | 0.78 | 2.40 | 0.56 | 1.40 |
| FBN Growth Program | 0.76 | 2.36 | 0.55 | 1.38 |
| FBN Scale Program | 0.74 | 2.30 | 0.54 | 1.35 |
| FBN Premier Program | 0.72 | 2.25 | 0.52 | 1.32 |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 0.69 | 2.18 | 0.50 | 1.28 |

## Terms common to every program

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Volume charged on | Average daily cubic feet per SKU in the storage month |
| Billing day | Day 15 of the month following the storage month |
| Peak-season months | October, November and December (months 10, 11 and 12) |
| Storage class by size tier | Small standard and large standard size tiers: standard class. Large bulky and extra large size tiers: oversize class |

## Reading the card

- A storage month that falls in October, November or December takes the peak column of its class; any other month takes the off-peak column.
- Example (hypothetical volume): a large bulky SKU averaging 120 cubic feet in a November storage month, in FBN Growth Program, falls in the oversize class and the peak column, 1.38 USD per cubic foot, giving 165.60 USD; the same volume in a May storage month takes 0.55 USD, giving 66.00 USD.
